name: record_interpretation
arguments: {"test_id": "T2", "per_hypothesis": [{"id": "H1", "verdict": "weakened", "why": "T2 found residue 45 in no predicted protein-protein interface (in_predicted_interface: false) and in none of the 1 P2Rank pockets (p2rank_pockets_containing_residue: []). Residue 45 does line 2 ProtVar pockets (pocket 5 score 572.2, buriedness 0.74; pocket 27 score 271.2, buriedness 0.79), which points away from a surface contact site. The would_refute criterion (solvent-exposed and more than about 10 \u00c5 from the WIP surface, with no change in interface contacts) was not met: T2 did not measure solvent exposure or distance to the WIP surface, and the interface call is marked not_covered. So the weakening is mild, not a refutation."}, {"id": "H2", "verdict": "supported", "why": "Residue 45 lies in two predicted pockets with high buriedness (0.74 and 0.79) on AF-P42768-F1, which is consistent with a buried, fold-relevant position. The pocket residues have mean pLDDT 84.0 and 85.4 (confidence control). This adds indirect support to H2 alongside T1 (FoldX ddG +3.56 kcal/mol, pLDDT 96.62 at residue 45). The would_refute criterion for H2 (buried residue with near-zero ddG and no clash) was not met, because T2 does not test the ddG and T1 gave +3.56 kcal/mol."}], "uncertainty": "T2 is a predicted-pocket and predicted-interface test on a single AlphaFold model (AF-P42768-F1, mean pLDDT 69.38 overall). Pocket membership and buriedness are computational predictions, not measured binding sites. The interface result is marked not_covered, so 'no interface' does not show that residue 45 is absent from the WIP interface. The buriedness values are pocket-level, not residue-level. The control results were: P2Rank 1 pocket, with no hit at residue 45; pocket confidence pLDDT 84.0 and 85.4. Neither T2 nor T1 used the WIP complex (9S9X) to measure distance to the WIP surface, so H1 cannot be refuted or confirmed from this test. Validation still needed: residue-level solvent accessibility and WIP-surface distance from 9S9X, and an experimental WASp level or folding measurement for T45M."}

name: record_decision
arguments: {"favoured_after": "H2", "why": "Previous favourite H2 (stability_folding) was kept. Its strongest rival H1 (protein_interaction) was weakened by T2 (test_id T2): residue 45 is in no predicted protein-protein interface and in none of the 1 P2Rank pockets. H2 gained indirect support from T2: residue 45 lies in 2 ProtVar pockets with buriedness 0.74 and 0.79 (pocket-level, pLDDT 84.0 and 85.4). Its direct evidence remains T1 (FoldX ddG +3.56 kcal/mol, pLDDT 96.62, control T45R +7.43), plus E14 (exon 2 Thr45Met family) and E7/E8/E9 (predictors). H1's direct support is still only domain annotation (E5, E6), the EVH1 review (E16) and a neighbouring-residue report (E15, L101P, not T45M), and the WIP-complex structure 9S9X (E10) does not measure distance to the WIP surface. The test did not refute H1, so the decision is not final. Decision changed: no."}
